ERR_RENDER_ALREADY_INSTALLED.message: The screen is already set up

ERR_RENDER_NOT_INSTALLED.message: The screen is not set up

ERR_RENDER_ROW_EXCEEDS_FLUSH_MAX.message: {id} takes at most {flush_max} bytes at once, less than one row ({row})

ERR_RENDER_ALLOC_FAILED.message: No memory for the screen: {bytes} bytes needed, the largest free block has {free}
ERR_RENDER_ALLOC_FAILED.hint: Use a smaller screen memory or fewer draw buffers.

ERR_RENDER_HEAP_BYTES_OUT_OF_RANGE.message: A screen memory of {heap_bytes} bytes is outside {min}..{max}

ERR_RENDER_POOL_BELOW_RESERVE.message: {need} more bytes would leave the screen less than its reserve of {reserve} ({free} free)
ERR_RENDER_POOL_BELOW_RESERVE.hint: Give the screen more memory or draw less at once.

ERR_RENDER_REFRESH_HZ_OUT_OF_RANGE.message: A refresh of {refresh_hz} Hz is outside {min}..{max}
